creative_direction: Show a snow hare sitting in a compact three-quarter pose beside a low rounded stone covered in small orange lichens. Its long ears lean in different directions, and its dark eye looks calmly toward the viewer. Paint the white coat through warm cream and cool lavender planes, reserving fine fur detail for the cheek, chest, and ear edges. Use a muted violet-gray background with no distant landscape. The lichen should provide a concentrated rust-orange counterpoint near the lower center, not cover the whole scene. Keep the paws and stone grounded in one soft shadow. Compose the hare as a distinct central silhouette with tactile detail visible on closer inspection.
